items.title: Show HN: GitCruiter – AI tool that evaluates developers by GitHub activity
items.raw_excerpt:
GitCruiter analyzes public GitHub data to estimate a developer’s technical level and habits.
Each profile generates a detailed report with metrics like Algorithmic Thinking, Code Quality, Project Organization, Testing Practices, Documentation, and Problem Solving, plus an overall score (e.g., Senior 80/100). You can browse developers by region, language, or framework — for example, “Python devs in Canada” or “React engineers in Eastern Europe.” We built it to make developer evaluation more transparent — no résumés, no mystery algorithms, just interpretable metrics from real repos and commits.
Would love feedback from developers on whether these evaluations feel accurate or how they could be improved.

items.title: Accelerate large-scale AI training with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod training operator
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we demonstrate how to deploy and manage machine learning training workloads using the Amazon SageMaker HyperPod training operator, which enhances training resilience for Kubernetes workloads through pinpoint recovery and customizable monitoring capabilities. The Amazon SageMaker HyperPod training operator helps accelerate generative AI model development by efficiently managing distributed training across large GPU clusters, offering benefits like centralized training process monitoring, granular process recovery, and hanging job detection that can reduce recovery times from tens of minutes to seconds.
